pages.title: Pawffee Break
pages.content:
Good coffee. Better company.

Pawffee Break is the perfect blend of specialty coffee culture and the unconditional love of pets. Whether you’re here to sip, study, or simply snuggle, every visit is a little break worth savoring.

01 — Our belief

We believe a good cup of coffee and a wagging tail can turn any day around. So we built a café where every latte comes with company, every visit slows the world down, and every resident is one hello away from a forever home.

02 — About us

A cozy escape, with paws.

Our café was created as a cozy escape where people can enjoy handcrafted brews while connecting with friendly paws and purrs.

It’s not just about sipping lattes — it’s about slowing down, sharing smiles, and finding comfort in the little things. Whether you’re here for a quick pick-me-up, a study session, or just some furry cuddles, Pawffee Break is your perfect pause.

posts.title: Welcome to Pawffee Break: Sip, Relax, Adopt!"
posts.content:
We’re thrilled to welcome you to Pawffee Break—Hamilton’s cozy pet café where coffee lovers and animal lovers unite

Visit us at:
234 Locke Street South, Hamilton, Ontario, L8P 4B9

At Pawffee Break, you can:

  • Enjoy our handcrafted coffees, teas, and fresh pastries.
  • Meet adoptable pets from our partnering local shelters.
  • Relax, study, or catch up with friends in a pet-friendly environment.
  • Participate in fun events like pet adoption days, art contests, and community fundraisers.
  • Learn how every latte helps find homes for rescue animals!

Contact us:
For adoption info, event bookings, or general inquiries,
call (901) 123-4567 or email pawffeebreak@cafemail.com

Follow us on Instagram @PawffeeBreakHamilton for daily updates and adorable pet photos!

Stop by soon—your new best friend could be waiting for you!

posts.title: Pet Care 101: Keep Your Furry Friends Happy & Healthy
posts.content:
Adopting a pet is a lifelong adventure, full of joy and new responsibilities. Whether you’re brand new or a seasoned pet parent, here are Pawffee Break’s top care tips:

  • Maintain a consistent routine for feeding, bathroom breaks, and walks.
  • Set aside time for daily play and positive bonding.
  • Make regular appointments with your veterinarian for check-ups and vaccinations.
  • Provide safe toys and comfy resting spots for both exercise and relaxation.
  • Watch for changes in behavior—sometimes little signs mean a lot!

Pro Tip:
Join our blog and events for more advice from local vets and experienced pet parents, or ask our staff for firsthand guidance. Happy pets make happy families!

For more information, check out this webpage. Home Pet Care 101

jobs.title: Barista & Café Host
jobs.content:
Looking for friendly, energetic baristas to serve delicious drinks and treats, create a welcoming atmosphere, and help coordinate pet meet-and-greet events. No experience needed — just a love for coffee and animals!

Key responsibilities

  • Prepare and serve café menu items
  • Keep the café clean, calm and welcoming for guests and residents
  • Help guests through the daily Pet Meet & Greet

jobs.title: Animal Care Assistant
jobs.content:
Join our team to care for our furry residents! Duties include feeding, cleaning, playtime, and supporting adoption meetups. Perfect for animal science students or anyone with a passion for rescue.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide daily care for cats, dogs and small animals
  • Keep living spaces clean and enriching
  • Support adoption meetups and share each resident's story

jobs.title: Events & Outreach Coordinator
jobs.content:
Help us spread the word! Coordinate in-café and outreach events to boost adoptions and bring the Pawffee Break mission into the community.

Key responsibilities

  • Organize and promote special events — adoption days, pet playdates, fundraisers
  • Build relationships with local rescues and businesses
  • Run our social channels and event listings
